mechanism_narrative: The three-week upward momentum in RETAIL_REC, reinforced by TRANSIT improving from -31.9 to -27.7, persists and lifts the next 28-day mean above the last 28-day mean.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is not higher than the last 28-day mean despite both RETAIL_REC and TRANSIT continuing their recent direction.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT weekly mean crosses above -25.0, commuting volume is high enough to restore weekday retail footfall, pushing RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -31.9 to -27.7 over the last four weeks
failure_condition: If TRANSIT crosses above -25.0 but RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is not higher than its last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Falling RESIDENTIAL from 4.0 to 3.1 and rising GROCERY_PHARM from 2.3 to 5.7 jointly indicate more out-of-home errands; this spillover lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL continues falling and GROCERY_PHARM stays above +5.0, yet RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is not higher than its last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Under policy easing, WORKPLACES stabilization above -7.0 prevents a retail setback because office occupancy supports lunchtime and after-work retail spending, lifting RETAIL_REC.
failure_condition: If in a policy-easing regime WORKPLACES stays above -7.0 but RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is lower than the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS falling below -15.0 signals unfavorable outdoor conditions, shifting recreation toward indoor retail and raising RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS dropped from -10.0 to -16.4 in t-0w
failure_condition: If PARKS falls below -15.0 but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than its last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES co-improvement indicates a durable commuting recovery; if TRANSIT rises while WORKPLACES stays at or above -7.0, retail footfall rises over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If TRANSIT rises and WORKPLACES stays at or above -7.0, but RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean does not exceed its last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: When RETAIL_REC itself crosses above -4.0 and TRANSIT remains above -30.0, self-reinforcing reopening sentiment drives further retail gains over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC weekly mean rises above -4.0 while TRANSIT is above -30.0
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC crosses above -4.0 while TRANSIT is above -30.0, but next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean is lower than its last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: A seasonal transition to warmer, drier conditions raises PARKS above -10.0, diverting recreation from indoor retail venues and lowering RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If PARKS rises above -10.0 during the next four weeks but RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is higher than or equal to its last 28-day mean.
